regex_ephemerality_none_hint: Neither ticked: the script edits the message itself, so the change is both shown in the chat and sent to the model, as SillyTavern does.
regex_order_hint: Scripts run top to bottom. Drag a script by its handle to change the order.

regex_delete_many_confirm.one: Delete {} script? This cannot be undone.
regex_delete_many_confirm.other: Delete {} scripts? This cannot be undone.

summary_outlook_text: The prompt may use {total} tokens. Fixed part {fixed}, summary {summary}, fresh history {history}. Threshold {trigger}, compact down to {compactTo}, least fresh history {floor}. A run would leave {tail} of fresh history as written.
summary_outlook_floor_only: Under the line to compact down to, next to the fixed part and the summary, there is less room than the least fresh history: a run leaves exactly the least, and the prompt after it sits a little above the line. Harmless while the gap is small. For a run to leave more, raise the line, lower the summary's share (merge threshold, block size), or slim the preset, card, lorebooks and memory.
summary_outlook_none: No prompt has been built in this chat yet: send a message, then open these settings again.
summary_prompt_retell_hint: Instruction for retelling one run of old messages as a block. In a saved prompt, macros are expanded ({{char}}, {{user}}, {{getvar::…}}); {{target_tokens}}, {{target_words}} and {{target_chars}} place the block size target in tokens, words and characters (a model keeps to words and characters, not tokens; the target in words and characters is appended unless the prompt places it), {{previous_summary}} the blocks before it (context only), {{history}} the transcript — a prompt that places the transcript is sent as one message, as written.
summary_insertion_hint: In place of the messages: each run of blocks goes into the history where the messages it retells were, oldest first. Relative: where the Summary block sits in the preset. At depth: that many messages from the end.
summary_prompt_merge_hint: Instruction for merging adjacent blocks a level up. {{target_tokens}}, {{target_words}} and {{target_chars}} place the size target in tokens, words and characters; the target in words and characters is appended unless the prompt places it. {{level}} places the level of the merged block.
summary_prompt_chat_own_hint: This chat keeps a prompt text of its own from before presets. Pick a preset to switch it over; the text can be copied from the current prompts.
summary_prompt_shorten_hint: Instruction for a block that came out well past its size target: it is sent back once with this prompt, and the shorter text is kept. {{target_tokens}}, {{target_words}} and {{target_chars}} place the size target in tokens, words and characters; the target in words and characters is appended unless the prompt places it.
summary_preamble_hint: Goes first in every summary prompt, for models that refuse to retell harsh scenes. By default it asks to retell them neutrally, without the detail, leaving nothing the story needs out. Applies to every chat.
summary_auto_hint: After a bot reply, once the prompt passes the threshold below, the oldest messages are retold as a block and sent in their place. Applies to every chat.
summary_trigger_hint: How full the context may get before old messages are summarized on their own. Compact history keeps its own tail, set below.
summary_compact_to_hint: How full the context window is left after a run: old messages are retold until the whole prompt — preset, card, lorebooks, memory, summary and the fresh history that is left — fills about this percent. A level of the prompt, not a share of the history. Never above the threshold.
summary_auto_floor_hint: How much of the newest history an automatic run always leaves as written, even when the preset, lorebooks and memory take nearly all the room.
summary_manual_tail_hint: How much of the newest history Compact history leaves as it is. Everything older goes into the summary, so the chat can go on from there and be compacted again later.
summary_manual_tail_percent_hint: Of the chat connection's context size.
summary_manual_tail_tokens_hint: Newest messages up to this many tokens stay as they are.
summary_block_target_hint: Target length of one block, in tokens. A short run of messages gets a shorter block; a merge aims at this size too.
summary_merge_hint: Once the summary takes more than this share of the context, adjacent blocks of one level are merged into one a level up. The merged blocks move to the archive.
summary_empty: No summary yet. It appears once the chat fills the context, or when you compact it yourself.
summary_stats: {} blocks • {} tokens • stand in for {} messages
summary_note_hint: Given to the model only when it retells messages for the summary; never sent in the chat request. Stands in for no messages and is never merged.
summary_block_stale: Source messages changed — not sent, they are back in history
summary_archive_hint: Blocks that were merged into a higher level. Deleting the merged block brings them back.
summary_nothing_to_compact: Nothing to compact: everything outside the fresh tail is already summarized, or too little has piled up.
summary_clear_hint: Deletes every block and the archive. Messages stay in the chat and return to the prompt.
summary_delete_block_hint: Its messages return to the prompt as they are.
summary_delete_merge_hint: The blocks it was merged from come back from the archive.
summary_delete_note_hint: The note will no longer be sent.
summary_error_busy: The summary is already being compacted.
summary_error_not_shorter: The summarizer returned text no shorter than its source. Lower the block size or use another model.
summary_error_not_shortened: The summarizer did not make the block shorter. Try again, pick another shortening prompt, or use another model.
summary_error_not_adjacent: Select blocks that follow each other.
summary_error_mixed_levels: Select blocks of the same level.
summary_error_changed: The chat changed while the summary was being written. Try again.
summary_error_stale_merge: The messages under this merge changed, so its parts are out of date too. Delete the merge to get its parts back, then regenerate them.
summary_error_sources_gone: None of this block's messages are left to retell. Delete the block instead.
summary_draft_stale: The messages changed, so this draft is out of date — regenerate it
theme_settings_from_theme: These settings come from the theme
theme_css_chip_hint: This theme brings its own layout and CSS
desc_allow_external_media: Lets messages load images, videos, audio, fonts and stylesheets from the internet. When off, only media embedded in the message itself is shown. Each remote load lets that site see your IP address.
menu_nav_rail_left: Tabs on the Left in Landscape
desc_nav_rail_left: With the phone turned sideways, shows the tab bar along the left edge instead of the right
imggen_tensorart_hint: Get an Access Key in TensorArt: Settings → Access Key. Keys starting with ak_tusi use the Tusi host automatically.
catalog_janitor_queue: JanitorAI is in queue. Glaze will continue automatically.
catalog_janitor_queue_wait: JanitorAI is in queue — estimated wait: {wait}. Glaze will continue automatically.
catalog_lorebooks_character_importing_hi: Lorebooks come next: once the character is in the library, you choose what to send to make their entries fire.
catalog_lorebooks_import_capture_note: The character import already collected entries with the default context ({} tok.). Collect again to use the context chosen above, or continue with those.
catalog_lorebooks_use_import_capture: Continue with entries from the import
lorebook_build_llm_desc: The connection and model that rebuild lorebooks into entries with keys: closed JanitorAI lorebooks and scripted ones. Left on the chat connection, builds use whichever LLM is selected.
catalog_ctx_greetings_pending: Not in the catalog — taken from the chat during extraction
catalog_lorebooks_preview_parts: The extracted content is too long for one request, so the build sends {} requests one after another, each with the same context and its own part of the content. Shown here is the first one.
catalog_lorebooks_err_part_resume: Part {} of {}: {} Building again resumes from this part.
catalog_extraction_split_hint: The model writes every entry back out in full, so its reply is as long as the extracted content. Content longer than one request is built in parts, one request after another, each with the same context.
catalog_extraction_split_toggle_desc: Off sends all the extracted content in one request, however long.
catalog_extraction_split_tokens_desc: In tokens. Keep it under your model's output limit. Also capped at half of the connection's context size.
catalog_error_janitor_queue: JanitorAI is still in its admission queue and did not let Glaze in. Try again in a few minutes.
perm_chat_page: Page over the chat (scripts keep their buttons and windows)
update_install_restart_hint: Glaze will close, update and start again. Your characters, chats and settings stay.
update_install_portable_hint: This copy of Glaze was not set up by the installer. The installer will open and install Glaze in its own folder; your characters, chats and settings stay.
update_install_failed_verify: The downloaded file didn't pass the check and was deleted
memory_draft_source_problems: This range can't be retold: {}. Fix those messages in the chat, then generate again.
memory_draft_source_all_hidden: every message of the range is hidden
history_anchor_pin_too_far: Too far back for the history to start there: the prompt would pass the trim trigger. The anchor stays where it was.
desc_history_trim_threshold: The anchor jumps once the whole prompt — everything the inspector counts, history included — reaches this share of the context window.
desc_history_trim_step: How much of the context window one jump frees. The freed share is how long the prompt keeps the same start, so a bigger step means rarer trims and longer cache hits, but less history in view. A step larger than the room the history has frees half of that room.
desc_tool_calling: Lets the chat model act in the app — for example, add a character to your library when you ask. Every change is shown to you for approval first. The model must support tool calling.
desc_tool_group_characters_create: The model can add new character cards to your library.
desc_tool_group_characters_edit: The model can change fields of existing character cards.
model_tools_confirm_source: Requested by the model in chat
